fields.name: Lease Number
fields.definition: Lease Number - The number assigned to a lease by the regulatory agency having jurisdiction over mineral activity in the territory where the lease is located.

fields.name: Filler
fields.definition: Filler

fields.name: Serial Type Code
fields.definition: Serial Type Code -Indicates the reason that a serial number is issued.

fields.name: Sale Number
fields.definition: Sale Number -The number designation assigned by the Minerals Management Service to specifically identify an Outer Continental Shelf lease sale.

fields.name: Filler
fields.definition: Filler

fields.name: Lease Expected Expiration Date
fields.definition: Lease Expected Expiration Date - YYYYMMDD - The anticipated day, month, and year on which the lease is scheduled to expire.

fields.name: API State County Code
fields.definition: API State County Code - A five-digit number identifier assigned to offshore Federal water areas, as recommended by API. This code becomes a part of the API well number.

fields.name: Tract Number
fields.definition: Tract Number - A number to uniquely identify the block(s) offered for a lease in an Outer Continental Lease sale assigned by the Minerals Management Service.

fields.name: Lease Effective Date
fields.definition: Lease Effective Date - YYYYMMDD - The date a lease becomes operative as assigned by the Mineral Management Service.

fields.name: Primary Term
fields.definition: Primary Term - The initial period (in years) of a lease.

fields.name: Lease Expiration Date
fields.definition: Lease Expiration Date - YYYYMMDD - The date a lease expires, is relinquished or terminated.

fields.name: Bid System Code
fields.definition: Bid System Code - Indicates the method by which royalties are determined for a lease or potential lease.

fields.name: Royalty Rate
fields.definition: Royalty Rate - Specified minimum annual royalty required from the leasehold.

fields.name: Filler
fields.definition: Filler

fields.name: Initial Area
fields.definition: Initial Area - The original surface area of a leasehold, unit, etc.

fields.name: Current Area
fields.definition: Current Area - The current total surface area of a leasehold including any assingnments or changes thereto.

fields.name: Rent per Unit
fields.definition: Rent Per Unit - The rent per unit of area payable by the lessee on the first day of each lease year prior to discovery of minerals in paying quantity, on the leasehold.

fields.name: Bid Amount
fields.definition: Bid Amount - A timely, sealed submittal to a mineral owner offering a monetary consideration for a specific property during a lease sale.

fields.name: Bid per Unit
fields.definition: Bid per Unit - The dollar amount of the bid received for a tract divided by the areal amount of the tract.

fields.name: Filler
fields.definition: Filler

fields.name: Block Low Water Depth
fields.definition: Block Low Water Depth - The point of the lowest (or minimum) vertical distance from mean sea level to the sea floor for a block.

fields.name: Block Max Water Depth
fields.definition: Block Max Water Depth - The point of the highest (or maximum) vertical distance from mean sea level to the sea floor for a block.

fields.name: System Measure Flag
fields.definition: System Measure Flag - A-Acres H-Hectares.

fields.name: MMS Planning Area Code
fields.definition: MMS Planning Area Code - Indicates an Outer Continental Shelf (OCS) group of offshore blocks that considered an entity for administrative planning purposes.

fields.name: Filler
fields.definition: Filler

fields.name: District Code
fields.definition: District Code - An indicator assigned to a sub-office of an Outer Continental Shelf (OCS) regional office which has delegated authority for field operations activities including: permitting wells, inspections, drilling, and production operations.

fields.name: Filler
fields.definition: Filler

fields.name: Lease Status Code
fields.definition: Lease Status Code Identifies the development stage of the lease as assigned by the Minerals Management Service's Office of Leasing and Environment.

fields.name: Lease Status Effective Date
fields.definition: Lease Status Effective Date - YYYYMMDD - The date that the development stage of a lease becomes operative.

fields.name: Suspension Expiration Date
fields.definition: Suspension Expiration Date - YYYYMMDD - The day, month, and year that a lease suspension of production or suspension of operations expires.

fields.name: Suspension Type Code
fields.definition: Suspension Type Code - Indicates whether the lease is help by a suspension of production or suspension of operations.

fields.name: Well Name
fields.definition: Well Name - The name assigned to the well. It may be a special name or the name of the property to which the well belogs.

fields.name: Qualifying Well Types
fields.definition: Qualifying Well Types - Indicates the type of well that is determined to be producible under Title 30 CFR 250.11, and therefore qualifies a lease as producible.

fields.name: Lease Qualifying Date
fields.definition: Lease Qualifying Date - The day, month, and year that a lease is determined capable of production in paying quantities as established by the Minerals Management Service.

fields.name: Discovery Type Code
fields.definition: Discovery Type Code - Indicates the type of mineral deposit discovered on a lease.

fields.name: Field Discovery Code
fields.definition: Field Discovery Code - Y - a new field is discovered - N - an extension of an existing field.

fields.name: Distance to Shore
fields.definition: Distance to Shore - The approximate distance to the nearest coastline. The nearest coastline may be an island or a point on the U. S. Shoreline.

fields.name: Filler
fields.definition: Filler

fields.name: Number of Platforms
fields.definition: Number of Platforms - Number of platforms located on a lease.

fields.name: Platform Approval Date
fields.definition: Platform Approval Date - YYYYMMDD - The date the first platform is approved by the Minerals Management Service for a lease.

fields.name: First Platform Set Date
fields.definition: First Platform Set Date - YYYYMMDD - The date that the first platform on a lease was installed.

fields.name: Lease Section Code
fields.definition: Lease Section Code - An indicator of the type of section (according to the OCS Lands Act) of federally administered portions of an OCS lease.

fields.name: Postal State Code
fields.definition: Postal State Code - Indicates the postal code for a single state that borders on the 8G line. If Postal State Code is null Section State Code is placed in this location. Section State Code - Indicates the two states associated with the section of the OCS Lands Act under which the lease was issued. (Two states bordering the 8G line.)

fields.name: Lease Section Area
fields.definition: Lease Section Area - The suface area of the federally administered portion of an OCS lease which has been designated as containing areas other than current or previous federal area.

fields.name: Protraction Number
fields.definition: Protraction Number - The identifier of an official protraction, which can be one of two types as utilized by the Minerals Management Service (MMS): an official Protraction Diagram (OPD) or Leasing Map.

fields.name: Filler
fields.definition: Filler

fields.name: Suspension Effective Date
fields.definition: Suspension Effective Date - YYYYMMDD - The day, month, and year that a suspension of production or suspension of operations holding a lease becomes operataive.

fields.name: First Production Date
fields.definition: First Production Date - YYYYMMDD - The date a lease is first placed on continuous extraction of solid minerals or flow of fluid minerals that is primarily for sale rather than for testing.

fields.name: Filler
fields.definition: Filler

fields.name: Area Code
fields.definition: Area Code - The designated abbreviation assigned to Outer Continental Shelf (OCS) geographical units for identification purposes and for use on maps and in databases.

fields.name: Filler
fields.definition: Filler

fields.name: Block Number
fields.definition: Block Number - Identifies a subdivision of an Official Protraction Diagram.

fields.name: Filler
fields.definition: Filler

fields.definition: OWNER_ALIQUOT_CD -Indicates different percentage ownerships within a lease as a result of a partial assignment.

fields.name: SN_LSE_OWNER
fields.definition: SN_LSE_OWNER -Autogenerated sequence number which uniquely identifies each instance of a lease owner.

fields.name: ASGN_APRV_DATE
fields.definition: ASGN_APRV_DATE -The date an assignment of interest is approved by the Minerals Management Service (MMS), and the date the official MMS records are changed.

fields.name: MMS_START_DATE
fields.definition: MMS_START_DATE -The date that a business entity began doing business with the Minerals Management Service.

fields.name: MMS_COMPANY_NUM
fields.definition: MMS_COMPANY_NUM -The number assigned by the Minerals Management Service to a business entity, individual, or agency with whom MMS does business or exchanges information.

fields.name: LEASE_NUMBER
fields.definition: LEASE_NUMBER - The number assigned to a lease by the regulatory agency having jurisdiction over mineral activity in the territory where the lease is located.

fields.name: ASGN_STATUS_CODE

fields.name: ASGN_TERM_DATE
fields.definition: ASGN_TERM_DATE -The date that a lease assignment is terminated by the Minerals Management Service.

fields.name: OWNER_GROUP_CODE
fields.definition: OWNER_GROUP_CODE -Indicates different percentage ownerships within a lease as a result of a partial assignment.

fields.name: ASSIGNMENT_PCT
fields.definition: ASSIGNMENT_PCT -The lessee's financial interest in a lease.

fields.definition: ASSIGNMENT_PCT -The lessee's financial interest in a lease.

fields.name: LEASE_DESIG_DATE
fields.definition: LEASE_DESIG_DATE -The date that a designation of operator form for a lease was approved by the Minerals Management Service.

fields.name: OPERATOR_NUM
fields.definition: OPERATOR_NUM -The number assigned by the Minerals Management Service to a business entity, individual, or agency with whom MMS does business or exchanges information.

fields.definition: MMS_COMPANY_NUM -The number assigned by the Minerals Management Service to a business entity, individual, or agency with whom MMS does business or exchanges information.

fields.name: MMS_START_DATE
fields.definition: MMS_START_DATE -The date that a business entity began doing business with the Minerals Management Service.

fields.name: BUS_ASC_NAME
fields.definition: BUS_ASC_NAME -The name of a **business associate**.

fields.name: SORT_NAME
fields.definition: SORT_NAME -The name of the business entity doing business on the OCS used for sorting purposes. For example, The Louisana Land and Exploration Company would have a short name of LOUISIANA LAND AND EXPLORATION COMPANY, THE and therefore sort with business entities whose name begins with "L."

fields.name: MMS_TERM_DATE
fields.definition: MMS_TERM_DATE -The date that a business entity is no longer qualified to do business on the OCS with MMS.

fields.name: PAC_REGION_CODE
fields.definition: PAC_REGION_CODE -Indicates whether a business associate is qualified with the Minerals Management Service's Pacific Region.

fields.name: GOM_REGION_CODE
fields.definition: GOM_REGION_CODE -Indicates whether a business associate is qualified with the Minerals Management Service's Gulf of America Region.

fields.name: ALASKA_RGN_CODE
fields.definition: ALASKA_RGN_CODE -Indicates whether a business associate is qualified with the Minerals Management Service (MMS) Alaska Regional Office.

fields.name: ATL_REGION_CODE
fields.definition: ATL_REGION_CODE -Indicates whether a business associate is qualified with the Minerals Management Service's Atlantic Region.

fields.name: DUNS_NUMBER
fields.definition: DUNS_NUMBER -The unique identifier assigned to a requesting business by Dun and Bradstreet. The first nine digits are assigned by Dun and Bradstreet, the last four are agreed to by the trading partners.

fields.name: TERM_ACTN_EFF_DT
fields.definition: TERM_ACTN_EFF_DT -The date that an action, such as a name change or merger, that causes a business entity to terminate is effective.

fields.name: TERMINATION_CODE
fields.definition: TERMINATION_CODE -Indicates the reason a business entity terminates its qualification status with the MMS.

fields.name: DIVISION_NAME
fields.definition: DIVISION_NAME -The name of the organizational division of an entity used as part of the mailing address.

fields.name: Line 1 Address
fields.definition: LINE_1_ADDRESS -The first line of a street address.

fields.name: Line 2 Address
fields.definition: LINE_2_ADDRESS -The second line of a street address.

fields.name: CITY_NAME
fields.definition: CITY_NAME -The name of the city for the mailing address.

fields.name: POSTAL_ST_CODE
fields.definition: POSTAL_ST_CODE -Indicates the postal code for a state.

fields.name: ZIP_CODE
fields.definition: ZIP_CODE -The Postal Service designator which delineates the state, county or parish, community, and possibly neighborhood for a residence or business entity.

fields.name: COUNTRY_NAME
fields.definition: COUNTRY_NAME -The name of the country other than the United States of America (USA) where a business entity receives correspondence.
